mapper.sql: group_code, platform_symbol, bid_extra, ask_extra, enabled, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_symbol_group_markup WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY group_code ASC, platform_symbol ASC
SELECT FROM t_symbol_group_markup WHERE updated_at > #{since} ORDER BY updated_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_symbol_group_markup (group_code, platform_symbol, bid_extra, ask_extra, enabled) VALUES (#{groupCode}, #{platformSymbol}, #{bidExtra}, #{askExtra}, #{enabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bid_extra = VALUES(bid_extra), ask_extra = VALUES(ask_extra), enabled = VALUES(enabled)
